# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the canonical repository rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), and [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md).

When authoring new automated tests or Screenplay building blocks, follow [.agents/skills/author-onspring-test/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/author-onspring-test/SKILL.md) and use `npm run agent -- <catalog|help-search|explore|verify>` to discover existing helpers, search local Help Center documentation, explore live Onspring pages, and validate your changes.
